name: Name
documented: In Session 1 Mark Starchenko sent written proposals through the team repository (PR #1 “Starchenko/session1 proposals”, merged 2026-11-18): split latest buy into its prefix (the ranker question) and its fill (the encoder question), which gives the baseline / encoder-only / ranker-only / both ablation used here, and a logistic-regression ranker of past assets as the classical control. For HW2 the team agreed that each member first builds an individual solution and the solutions are merged afterwards. Aleksei Kosychev's individual solution tests the encoder fill with the same embedding model on nine development cutoffs and finds it the worst fill for customers who buy an asset new to them; my A1 result on the full warm cohort points the same way.
todo: After the individual solutions, Aleksei Kosychev merged his and Mark Starchenko’s solutions (team repository commit 9943877, 25 November 2026) and proposed the team pipeline: logistic-regression prefix + popularity fill, with no LLM component for now. My solution was not yet in the team repository, so that merge does not include it; my labelled-sample result (the LLM ranker below latest buy, Table 3) supports the proposal. Open: whether an LLM that cannot drop past assets adds anything on the new-asset side (my next experiment).
